may result in a restatement of our annual or interim financial statements.
Our reporting currency is the U.S. dollar and the functional currency of our international operations is its local currency.
These reclassifications have no impact on the unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements.
The historical basis of accounting was retained as if the entities had always been combined for financial reporting purposes.
This prospectus does not contain all of the information set forth in the registration statement and the exhibits and schedules thereto.

rows.label: Finding
rows.value: The final IPO prospectus supplies the earlier Q1 reported pair. Both operands match the retained 2026 Q1 comparative. Its FY2024/FY2023 annual selected lines also match the FY2025 annual filing comparatives. This resolves those specific earlier-edition and affected-line comparisons, alongside saved Q2/H1 matches. No ratio or synthetic quarter is calculated; pro forma EPS and adjusted EBITDA are excluded.

rows.label: Limit
rows.value: Matching tested statements does not certify unreviewed registration editions or every accounting line. Prospective restatement/control-risk language is not an actual correction. The disclosed February 2023 auditor change is not a FY2025 correction; its referenced letter is not treated as reviewed assurance.
